en: The postcard image shows a street scene in a European town, characterized by late 19th or early 20th-century architecture. There is a prominent multi-story building on the right with decorative elements, shops, and signs. Several people are seen walking or standing, some in period dress. In the background, two tall church towers with pointed spires rise above the rooftops, indicating a notable cathedral or church. The street is cobbled and lined with other multi-story town buildings.
